sources.title: Slovak Film Commission: Cash Rebate
sources.said: A 33% cash rebate on expenses spent on film or TV production in the Slovak Republic. … €300,000 ($300,000) for television series of max. 26 episodes spent in the Slovak Republic over a period of 3 years, after project registration. … There is no budget limit on eligible costs; no requirement to guarantee theatrical or non-theatrical distribution in Slovak Republic. … Project must pass the cultural test – maximum points 48, minimum 24 points.
